how_to_apply: Apply through the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways at http://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in from 4.11.2026 to 3.12.2026.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Member of Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or of Institute of Cost and Works Accountants of India; For absorption: officers holding analogous posts or Dy. Chief Accounts Officer and equivalent posts in respective discipline of Finance Deptt. in the scale of pay of Rs.13000-18250 with 3 years regular service in the grade Rs.13000-18250 in a Major Port Trust; Or Dy. Chief Accounts Officer and equivalent posts in respective discipline of Finance Deptt. with 2 years regular service in the grade and a combined regular service of 7 years in the scales of pay of Rs.10750-16750 and Rs.13000-18250 in a Major Port Trust; Overall grading in the APARs not below Very Good Experience: Twelve years experience in executive cadre in the field of Finance, Accounting in an industrial/commercial/Govt. Undertaking (prescribed for direct recruitment; not applicable in case of absorption/deputation) Age limit: Maximum 42 years (as on 1 January 2027) Other conditions: Open only to eligible and willing officers of all Major Port Authorities Crucial date for eligibility criteria is 1.1.2027 Applications must come through proper channel from the administrative Port

content_sections.text: Candidates whose applications are not received through proper channel from the Port within 15 days of the last date

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Filled by absorption through composite method, failing which by deputation, and failing both by direct recruitment Class-I selection post; period of probation N.A.

content_sections.heading: How Will MbPA Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Selection by merit, with overall APAR grading not below Very Good Selection by Services Selection Committee Selection is by merit; benchmark is overall APAR grading not below Very Good Officials who withdraw after selection by the Services Selection Committee are liable to two years' debarment from Dy. HoD level posts in all Major Port Authorities

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Certified copies of APARs for the last 5 years (2020-21 to 2024-25), attested on each page by an officer not below Dy. HOD rank Attested photocopies of certificates of educational qualification and present and past work experience No objection certificate from the respective Port, and administrative clearance (Annexure II) Undertaking not to withdraw candidature if selected; vigilance report in Annexure III format Two passport size photographs; details of any major or minor penalty in the last 10 years

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MbPA Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply through the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways at http://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in from 4.11.2026 to 3.12.2026. No application submitted other than through OAP will be accepted. Submit the hard copy of the application form uploaded in OAP with requisite documents to your administrative Port. The administrative Port forwards it to MbPA superscribing 'Application for the post of Sr. Deputy Chief Accounts Officer in Mumbai Port Authority' on or before 18.12.2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Advance copy will not be considered if the application does not come through proper channel within 15 days of the last date Applications received after 18.12.2026 will not be considered All documents must be enclosed at one time; no piecemeal forwarding

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MbPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 3 December 2026. Applications opened on 4 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MbPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Sr. Deputy Chief Accounts Officer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MbPA Recruitment 2026?

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open only to eligible and willing officers of all Major Port Authorities. Crucial date for eligibility criteria is 1.1.2027. Applications must come through proper channel from the administrative Port.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates whose applications are not received through proper channel from the Port within 15 days of the last date.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection by merit, with overall APAR grading not below Very Good. Selection by Services Selection Committee. Selection is by merit; benchmark is overall APAR grading not below Very Good. Officials who withdraw after selection by the Services Selection Committee are liable to two years' debarment from Dy. HoD level posts in all Major Port Authorities.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Filled by absorption through composite method, failing which by deputation, and failing both by direct recruitment. Class-I selection post; period of probation N.A.
